title: Pathfinder: release flowboard (staged rollouts + rollback quick-actions)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce 'Flowboard', a timeline-first UX for composing staged rollouts with live risk envelopes, synthetic traffic previews, and one-click rollback quick-actions. Goal is to reduce cognitive load for SREs and PMs when launching model variants or config changes and to surface actionable telemetry and cost deltas before and during exposure.
background_and_goals: Current rollout composer screens are form-heavy and split across multiple tabs; users report difficulty predicting impact and executing emergency rollbacks.
Flowboard combines a horizontal timeline, cohort splitter, safety-gate cards, and an integrated 'telemetry preview' panel so teams can rehearse and execute staged releases from a single surface.

Success metrics: 30% faster time-to-launch for standard canaries; 50% reduction in manual rollback steps during incidents; decreased post-launch quality regressions measured by routine evals and alert rates.
scope_and_deliverables: Interactive Figma prototype demonstrating: create rollout -> schedule phases -> attach safety gates -> run synthetic preview -> initiate rollout -> execute rollback quick-action
Design tokens and component specs for timeline, risk envelope, policy cards, and quick-action modal
Hand-off package and acceptance criteria for ENG to implement guided MVP
constraints_and_assumptions: Telemetry ingestion latency can be up to ~15s for some customers; real-time risk envelope will use a 30s smoothing window in MVP
Backend will expose a rollout preview API (ENG contract required) that simulates metric deltas for configured cohorts
Rollback must be able to initiate pre-existing route configurations; full state reconciliation out of scope for MVP
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Timeline-first approach (vs. modal wizard) because it scales to >5 phases and makes sequencing explicit
Tradeoff: Showing conservative risk envelopes (wider bands) to avoid overconfidence given telemetry lag; may lead to additional perceived risk on small launches
Decision: Expose cost-delta estimates inline to encourage cost-aware rollouts; approximation acceptable if accompanied by a disclaimer
acceptance_criteria: Designer-reviewed Figma prototype with clickable interactions for scheduling and rollback
PM sign-off on safety-gate interaction patterns and default thresholds
Eng confirms feasibility of preview API and rollback contract (ENG-91522) and marks technical debt tasks
Usability test (5 participants) with SRE/PM users — majority complete a staged rollout and rollback rehearsal without facilitator prompts

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Telemetry gaps cause noisy risk bands — Mitigation: conservative defaults + 'preview mode' explanation
Risk: Engineers estimate large surface area for timeline component — Mitigation: phased implementation (MVP timeline + expanded editor later)
Risk: Users accidentally execute rollback — Mitigation: require typed confirmation and show pre-populated impact summary
